why: Each row has the three outlines (hourglass, triangle, cross) and the three line types (a + of lines, an arrow, an X of lines), each used once. The last row already has a triangle with an X and a cross with a +. So the missing figure is the hourglass with an arrow: option 5. Option 2 is an hourglass but with an X, which the row already has.
trick: In a 3x3 grid, list what each row already has; the missing cell takes what is left.
